links.outcome: ChatGPT accuracy on orthopaedic in-training exam questions versus resident percentiles and pass threshold
links.effect: ChatGPT answered 47% (97 of 207) correctly; scored 40th percentile for PGY1s, 8th for PGY2s, 1st for PGY3-5; unlikely to pass written boards. Accuracy fell with taxonomy level (54%, 51%, 34%; p = 0.034).
links.quote: ChatGPT selected the correct answer 47% (97 of 207) of the time, and 53% (110 of 207) of the time it answered incorrectly.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of ChatGPT against human residents on questions from the Orthopaedic In-Training Examination without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
